name: friction
description: Count recurring friction across the development setup and surface only small fixes for symptoms that persist

config_repos.title: Config repos
config_repos.description: Local clones that hold the setup's config. A run checks each finding against them and opens its fixes there. Empty grounds findings against the config files the tools read.

atuin_db.title: Atuin database
atuin_db.description: Path to Atuin's history.db. Empty uses ~/.local/share/atuin/history.db.
